# The Wall Street Journal

> The Wall Street Journal provides reporting, analysis, and commentary on business, markets, politics, technology, personal finance, and culture.

WSJ.com is the digital home of The Wall Street Journal, offering breaking news, in-depth coverage, opinion, newsletters, podcasts, and topic pages across global business and public affairs.

## News Sections
- [World](https://www.wsj.com/news/world): International news, geopolitics, and global developments.
- [U.S.](https://www.wsj.com/news/us): National news, policy, courts, and major domestic stories.
- [Politics](https://www.wsj.com/politics): Coverage of elections, Congress, the White House, and political strategy.
- [Economy](https://www.wsj.com/economy): Reporting on inflation, jobs, growth, and economic policy.
- [Business](https://www.wsj.com/business): Corporate news, industries, leadership, and company developments.
- [Tech](https://www.wsj.com/tech): Technology companies, AI, devices, platforms, and digital policy.
- [Markets](https://www.wsj.com/finance/stocks): Stock market news, investing trends, and trading coverage.
- [Real Estate](https://www.wsj.com/real-estate): Housing, commercial property, and luxury real estate coverage.

## Finance & Investing
- [Stocks](https://www.wsj.com/finance/stocks): News and analysis on equities, indexes, and public companies.
- [Bonds](https://www.wsj.com/market-data/bonds): Bond market data, yields, and fixed-income coverage.
- [Currencies](https://www.wsj.com/market-data/currencies): Exchange rates, forex moves, and currency market information.
- [Commodities](https://www.wsj.com/market-data/commodities): Prices and reporting on energy, metals, and agricultural commodities.
- [Mutual Funds](https://www.wsj.com/market-data/mutualfunds-etfs): Data and coverage for mutual funds and ETFs.
- [Markets Data Center](https://www.wsj.com/market-data): Central hub for market quotes, charts, and financial data.
- [Heard on the Street](https://www.wsj.com/news/heard-on-the-street): WSJ's markets and corporate finance analysis column.

## Personal Finance
- [Personal Finance](https://www.wsj.com/personal-finance): Guidance on saving, spending, taxes, and household money decisions.
- [Retirement](https://www.wsj.com/personal-finance/retirement): Retirement planning, pensions, Social Security, and later-life finances.
- [Taxes](https://www.wsj.com/personal-finance/taxes): Tax policy, filing guidance, and taxpayer-focused reporting.
- [Banking](https://www.wsj.com/personal-finance/banking): Savings accounts, interest rates, and consumer banking coverage.
- [Credit Cards](https://www.wsj.com/personal-finance/credit-cards): Credit card news, rewards, fees, and borrowing advice.
- [Mortgages](https://www.wsj.com/personal-finance/mortgages): Mortgage rates, refinancing, and home loan reporting.

## Life & Work
- [Life & Work](https://www.wsj.com/lifestyle): Lifestyle coverage on careers, relationships, health, and daily living.
- [Careers](https://www.wsj.com/lifestyle/careers): Workplace trends, job searches, management, and professional development.
- [Health](https://www.wsj.com/health): Healthcare industry, wellness, and medical news.
- [Travel](https://www.wsj.com/lifestyle/travel): Travel news, destinations, airlines, and hospitality coverage.
- [Food](https://www.wsj.com/lifestyle/food): Restaurant trends, recipes, and food industry reporting.
- [Style](https://www.wsj.com/style): Fashion, luxury, design, and consumer style coverage.
- [Sports](https://www.wsj.com/sports): Sports business, major events, and athlete-focused reporting.

## Arts, Culture & Ideas
- [Books & Arts](https://www.wsj.com/news/books-arts): Coverage of books, film, television, music, and cultural trends.
- [Arts in Review](https://www.wsj.com/news/types/arts-in-review): Reviews of books, films, theater, music, and exhibitions.
- [Film](https://www.wsj.com/news/types/film-review): Film reviews, releases, and cinema commentary.
- [Television](https://www.wsj.com/news/types/television-review): Television reviews and streaming recommendations.
- [Masterpiece Series](https://www.wsj.com/news/types/masterpiece): Essays and features on notable works and creators.
- [House of the Day](https://www.wsj.com/real-estate/house-of-the-day): Featured homes with reporting on architecture and luxury property.

## Opinion
- [Opinion](https://www.wsj.com/opinion): Editorials, columns, and commentary on public affairs and markets.
- [Editorial Board](https://www.wsj.com/news/types/review-outlook-u-s): Unsigned editorials from the WSJ editorial board.
- [Commentary](https://www.wsj.com/news/types/commentary): Opinion essays from WSJ contributors and columnists.
- [Letters to the Editor](https://www.wsj.com/news/types/letters): Reader responses to WSJ opinion and news coverage.
- [The Future View](https://www.wsj.com/news/types/future-view): Student and emerging-writer opinion essays on current issues.
- [Best of the Web](https://www.wsj.com/news/types/best-of-the-web-today): Daily roundup and commentary on notable online stories.

## Audio, Video & Newsletters
- [Podcasts](https://www.wsj.com/podcasts): WSJ podcast directory covering news, markets, and business.
- [The Journal.](https://www.wsj.com/podcasts/the-journal): Daily news podcast from WSJ and Gimlet.
- [What's News](https://www.wsj.com/podcasts/whats-news): Short-form podcast on top WSJ headlines and developments.
- [WSJ News Exclusive](https://www.wsj.com/video/series/wsj-news-exclusive/8A0B15A7-0D7D-4D4A-9E5A-8E6A8D2A5D3F): Video interviews and reporting tied to exclusive stories.
- [Video](https://www.wsj.com/video): Video hub for interviews, explainers, and news segments.
- [Newsletters](https://www.wsj.com/newsletters): Email newsletters across markets, politics, and lifestyle topics.

## Topics, Authors & Latest Coverage
- [Latest Headlines](https://www.wsj.com/news/latest-headlines): Continuously updated stream of recent WSJ stories.
- [My Journal](https://www.wsj.com/myjournal): Personalized saved articles and followed topics for subscribers.
- [Authors](https://www.wsj.com/news/authors): Directory of WSJ reporters, columnists, and contributors.
- [News Archive](https://www.wsj.com/news/archive): Archived coverage organized by date and section.
- [Latest on Donald Trump](https://www.wsj.com/topics/person/donald-trump): Topic page aggregating coverage about Donald Trump.
- [Latest on Federal Reserve](https://www.wsj.com/topics/company-list/federal-reserve): Topic page for Federal Reserve news and analysis.

## Subscription & Account
- [Subscribe](https://www.wsj.com/subscribe): Subscription offers and plans for digital and print access.
- [Sign In](https://accounts.wsj.com/login): Account login for subscribers and registered users.
- [Customer Center](https://customercenter.wsj.com/): Account management, billing, and subscription support.
- [Gift Subscriptions](https://www.wsj.com/subscriptions/gift): Purchase gift subscriptions to The Wall Street Journal.
- [Student Offer](https://www.wsj.com/studentoffer): Discounted subscription offers for students.
- [Corporate Subscriptions](https://www.wsj.com/corporate-subscriptions): Enterprise and group subscription options.
